open_premises: [I] the leak along the trajectory: gate_silence and gate_firing (research/circuit/lean/CircuitInverterGateProof.lean, proof/inverter-bridge 13aba3a, built and audited here) take a time-varying leak with gap |leak u - a'| <= alpha and stateBound |actual u| <= X as hypotheses. The gate checks that both measured side rates lie in [a' - alpha, a' + alpha] and that the measured max |x| <= H0 hl (StateBound). That the cell's leak at every time is one of the two fitted side rates is a modelling step, not a measurement of leak(t).

the measured real hypotheses of gate_silence and gate_firing (actualLaw, integrability, initialError, helpError on every prefix, inhibitorySign and wrongSign split, wrongCharge, charge, offCharge, thresholdError, actualCont) are claims of the simulation, supplied as the outward-rounded numbers; they are not derived in Lean.
the latch: the contact-to-latch delay is a measured constant, not a proved bound.
